stories.title: The Water That Falls on You from Nowhere
stories.author: John Chu
stories.fit: A Hugo-winning speculative story with a clean what-if premise--water falls whenever someone lies--but the real hook is a clear, intimate family-and-relationship plot rather than abstract allegory.
stories.recommendation_note: Added by weekly short-story recommendation workflow.

stories.title: The Merchant and the Alchemist's Gate
stories.author: Ted Chiang
stories.fit: An award-winning, idea-driven time-travel story with a strong narrative hook: a merchant hears intertwined accounts of an alchemical gate that lets people confront the consequences of choices already made. It scratches the Ted Chiang itch without being abstract or fable-like.
